    origin = os.getenv("ORIGIN", "")
    if origin:
        app.add_middleware(
            CORSMiddleware,
            allow_origins=[origin],
            allow_credentials=True,
            allow_methods=["*"],
            allow_headers=["*"],
        )
    app.include_router(router)
    return app
